mechanics.claim: The wave narrows and accelerates after travelling 500 units, which can change whether it still hits the target in a moving fight, though not in the stationary dummy fight.
mechanics.quote: After travelling 500 units, the wave accelerates but also narrows itself.

mechanics.claim: The ability fires from Vex's position at the end of the cast time, not where she was at the start.
mechanics.quote: ''Mistral Bolt'' will fire from wherever '''Vex''' is at the end of the cast time, towards the originally targeted location
